FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 282
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/15/2025
Senate Bill 282 as introduced would exempt virtual currency from ad valorem taxation. Virtual
currency is not currently subject to ad valorem tax, and due to this, this bill would not directly
affect state or local funding.
